desc: Derive the segment-tree state indexed by the first split position and prove the range update caused by appending one element to the middle segment.
Precompute suffix distinct counts for every possible beginning of the third subarray.
Implement range-add and range-maximum queries with lazy propagation, ensuring only valid non-empty left and middle partitions are considered.
Verify initialization and iteration bounds for the cases where the middle or right subarray has length one.
Produce a Python stdin/stdout solution with \(O(N \log N)\) time and \(O(N)\) memory.
